codeReview.summary: Thorough test consolidation across 7 files in 5 crates, reducing test count from ~904 to 838 (net -66 tests) while maintaining behavioral coverage. The worker correctly followed the skill procedure: identified low-value/duplicate tests, wrote consolidated parameterized versions first, then removed originals. All removed scenarios have equivalent coverage either in the same file (parameterized consolidation) or in dedicated unit test crates (launa-ota, launa-mqtt, launa-core).

issues.description: Comment references 'simulate_ota_download' function which was removed. The comment says 'SimHttpServer and simulate_ota_download are used by SpaApp OTA pipeline tests later in this file' but simulate_ota_download no longer exists. This is a stale comment — the function was correctly removed as dead code, but the comment should have been updated to only mention SimHttpServer.

The consolidated test_log_entry_to_json_levels_and_timestamps uses a for loop over 3 (level, timestamp) tuples but does not print the failing case on assertion failure. The assert! messages in test_log_entry_to_json_escapes_each_special_char include good diagnostic messages with format!, but the levels_and_timestamps test does not. Minor — test failure would still be identifiable from line numbers.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker used parameterized test patterns (for loops with assertion arrays) consistently across remote_log.rs, discovery.rs, and http.rs consolidation. This is a good pattern for reducing test count while maintaining coverage, but it's not documented as a project convention in AGENTS.md or the mission AGENTS.md. If future workers need to consolidate tests, they would benefit from this pattern being documented.

summary: PASS. The consolidate-tests feature successfully reduced the test suite from ~904 to 838 tests (-66) across 5 crates with -1448 net lines removed. (3) HTTP parsing tests consolidated from ~16 individual tests to 15 parameterized tests across 6 functions. (4) 2 trait-check tests removed from launa-hal. (5) 36+ duplicate tests removed from launa-integration-tests/src/lib.rs (OTA mock, discovery, parse_ota_url, remote_log buffer tests all confirmed covered by dedicated crate tests). (6) Dead code suppressions and unused helper methods removed from temperature_physics_tests.rs and lib.rs. All tests pass, no warnings, no #[allow(dead_code)] remaining in test code.
